## 1) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Restore the Lithuanian `totpStep1` translations, which were replaced with Italian

Affected:
- themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties:101-101
- themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties:71-71

Explanation:
The Lithuanian `totpStep1` and `loginTotpStep1` values now contain Italian text: "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:". Lithuanian users will see a sentence in the wrong language on the OTP setup page. The other locales in this change got proper translations, so this looks like a copy/paste mistake.

Proposed fix:
~~~properties
totpStep1=Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:
loginTotpStep1=Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:
~~~

## 2) Severity: LOW | Type: Bug
Title: Use Simplified Chinese, not Traditional Chinese, in `messages_zh_CN`

Affected:
- themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties:112-112

Explanation:
The new `zh_CN` value "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：" is written in Traditional Chinese (手機, 應用程式), which is the `zh_TW` wording. The `zh_CN` bundle should use Simplified characters, like the rest of the file.

Proposed fix:
~~~properties
totpStep1=在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：
~~~

## 3) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Check that `{0}` and choice syntax work in the React (i18next) bundles before switching from `{{0}}`

Affected:
- js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties:188-188
- js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties:3138-3138

Explanation:
These bundles are used by the React UIs, which translate with i18next. The previous value used i18next interpolation (`{{0}}`). The new value uses `java.text.MessageFormat` syntax: `{0}` and `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`.

Unless the server converts these strings for the JS apps (that code is not visible in this diff), the UI will show the raw text, e.g. "Attribute {0} must have at least {1} ... {2,choice,...}". It seems the change was made to satisfy the new verifier, because the `{{` placeholders produced `<!-- -->` artifacts in the sanitizer.

Fix: confirm how these bundles are interpolated at runtime. If it is i18next, keep `{{0}}` placeholders and plain pluralization (or i18next plurals) for these files, and adjust the verifier instead.

Proposed fix:
~~~properties
error-invalid-multivalued-size=Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).
~~~

## 4) Severity: LOW | Type: Bug
Title: Guard the diff-trimming logic against overlapping prefix and suffix

Affected:
- misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:101-111

Explanation:
`start` and `end` are computed independently. When the common prefix and suffix overlap in the shorter string, `start > sanitized.length() - end` (or the same for `value`). `substring` then throws `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException`. This crashes the build instead of reporting the HTML problem.

Fix: limit `end` so that `start + end` never exceeds the length of either string.

Proposed fix:
~~~java
int end = 0;
int max = Math.min(value.length(), sanitized.length()) - start;
while (end < max && value.charAt(value.length() - end - 1) == sanitized.charAt(sanitized.length() - end - 1)) {
    end++;
}
~~~

## 5) Severity: LOW | Type: Implementation
Title: Fail with a clear message when no English counterpart exists, using the Mojo exception type

Affected:
- misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:66-80

Explanation:
The English file path is derived from the absolute path with two regex replacements. If no English file exists for a bundle, `verifySafeHtml` throws a raw `RuntimeException`. This aborts the whole plugin run with a stack trace, instead of adding a message or throwing `MojoExecutionException` like the rest of `verify()`.

Fix:
- Propagate `MojoExecutionException`, or add a readable message to `messages`.
- Derive the path from the file name instead of regex-rewriting the full absolute path.

Proposed fix:
~~~java
private void verifySafeHtml() throws MojoExecutionException {
    ...
    } catch (IOException e) {
        throw new MojoExecutionException("Can not read English source file " + englishFile + " for " + file, e);
    }
~~~

## 6) Severity: LOW | Type: Maintainability
Title: Include the key and file in the anchor-mismatch message

Affected:
- misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:157-157

Explanation:
"Didn't find anchor tag ... in original string" does not say which file or key failed. Across dozens of locale files, this makes failures hard to locate. The `key` parameter is passed into the method but never used.

Proposed fix:
~~~java
messages.add("Didn't find anchor tag " + matcher.group() + " in original string for key " + key + " in file " + file);
~~~

## 7) Severity: LOW | Type: Implementation
Title: Make `ANCHOR_PATTERN` match only real `<a>` tags

Affected:
- misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:145-145

Explanation:
`</?a[^>]*>` also matches tags that merely start with "a", such as `<abbr>`, `<area>`, `<audio ...>` and `<aside>`. Matching tags are stripped before sanitization. As a result, such tags copied from the English source are exempt from the sanitizer policy, and they are treated as anchors in the error output.

Proposed fix:
~~~java
private static final Pattern ANCHOR_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("</?a(\\s[^>]*)?>");
~~~
